notes.title: 🎉 Steam: Rails to Riches is bundled with Inkborn for a limited time! 🖋️
notes.content:
[h2]🎁 TIME-LIMITED BUNDLE DEALS[/h2]
We're incredibly excited to bring you the first major milestone of [b]Inkborn [/b]- [b]now available in Early Access on Steam![/b] To celebrate the launch, Inkborn is currently bundled for a [b]limited time[/b] with other great games from [b]Acram Franchise[/b] - you get an extra 17% off, [b]summing up to 25% total discount[/b] for the game with Steam: Rails to Riches:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/56753

🛍️ [b]Explore all bundles and deals:[/b] https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Acram/sale/WhispersOnPaper


✒️ Experience the full tactical core of the game, with the addition of Act 2, you'll face new enemies, unlock more cards, and dive even deeper into the evolving challenge that awaits:

🃏 Craft your deck from [b]over 60 hand-designed cards[/b], each built with synergy in mind.
🧠 Discover the brand new tactical layer where card order truly matters. Unleash [b]25 Glyph-based combos[/b], each more surprising and synergistic than the last. Make meaningful decisions and discover multiple new ways to play your hand and refine a deck.
⚔️ Challenge [b]19 unique opponents[/b], each with their own fighting mechanics, strategies, and surprises.
🎲 Face over [b]35 encounters[/b], from intense battles to rare narrative events. Every run brings something new.
💡 Acquire [b]20 Ideas[/b]. Defeated enemies immediately drop consumable items, either for momentary use or to carry into future battles.
🔥 Earn ability points and customize your skill tree before each run. Choose from [b]14 different skills[/b] to shape your strategy for the journey ahead.
🗺️ Traverse procedurally generated, non-linear maps where each step reveals unknown paths hidden beneath the fog of war.
💥 [b]Play through Act 1 and 2[/b] for deeper challenges and tuned Boss-fights. A real taste of what's to come in the full release.

🔗 [b]Grab Inkborn with a launch discount:[/b] 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2924580/Inkborn/?utm_source=steamsteamrtr&utm_medium=EArelease?utm_campaign=announcement

notes.title: Steam: Rails to Riches is a part of Turn-Based Carnival 2024! 🎲
notes.content:
[b]Steam: Rails to Riches[/b] is joining another exciting edition of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Acram/sale/Turn-BasedCarnival2024][b]Turn-Based Carnival[/b][/url]!

This event is a tribute to the games that make us think, plan, and savor every move. It's a chance to celebrate the creativity, depth, and diversity of turn-based gameplay. 👇

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Acram/sale/Turn-BasedCarnival2024][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34953556/96dad9192d8cbcd0dc58b95033113ed9362507dd.png[/img][/url]

But that’s not all!

We have some exciting news to share! Alongside the [b]Turn-Based Carnival[/b], we are proud to announce our first original game - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2924580/Inkborn/&utm_source=Steam&utm_medium=TBCxInkborne&utm_campaign=Announcement][b]Inkborn[/b][/url], a roguelike deckbuilder that takes players on a dynamic, strategic journey unlike anything you've experienced before. Set to release on [b]Early Access in Q2 2025[/b]! 🖋️

What sets [b]Inkborn[/b] apart? 🃏
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2924580/Inkborn/&utm_source=Steam&utm_medium=TBCxInkborne&utm_campaign=Announcement][b]Inkborn[/b][/url] features an innovative combo system where players discover powerful moves by playing cards in specific sequences, reminiscent of classic fighting game combos but with a unique twist. Our original [b]Origami art style[/b] and evolving roster of character classes make every run feel unique. At launch, players can experiment with [b]over 100 kinds of cards[/b], and we'll be expanding the game with more characters, cards, and features leading up to the [b]Full Release in Q2 2026[/b]. 🎮

Stay tuned for more updates, and prepare to embark on an unforgettable journey of intricate folds and strategic choices. Add [b]Inkborn[/b] to your wishlist and follow to stay in the loop! 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2924580/Inkborn/?utm_source=Steam&utm_medium=TBCxInkborne&utm_campaign=Announcement

notes.title: 👀 Who this might be...? 👀
notes.content:
We are proud to announce our first original game - [b]Inkborn[/b],

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34953556/1ecc5336ba6439da731f6d4124077b5c6599dadc.jpg[/img]

It is a [b]roguelike deckbuilder[/b] that takes players on a dynamic, strategic journey unlike anything you've experienced before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39565327/e107b13abdee35ee91eb124aeecfb2c48be36a4d.gif[/img]

[h2]What sets Inkborn apart?[/h2]
[b]Inkborn[/b] features an innovative [b]combo system[/b] where players discover powerful moves by playing cards in specific sequences, reminiscent of classic fighting game combos but with a unique twist. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39565327/4e9dfa217ce04ced112f19ae5df5a03284fde719.gif[/img]

Our original [b]Origami art style[/b] and evolving roster of character classes make every run feel [b]unique[/b]. At launch, players can experiment with [b]over 100 kinds of cards[/b], and we'll be expanding the game with more characters, cards, and features.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39565327/a9015f8bd48ac1c657d4c8705c8f5e548def7c75.gif[/img]

To make this project truly special, we're collaborating with [b]Jamey Stegmaier[/b], the popular and award-winning board game designer behind [b]Scythe[/b], [b]Charterstone[/b], and [b]Viticulture[/b]. Jamey's expertise has been a huge asset in creating distinctive game mechanics and enhancing the strategic depth of [b]Inkborn[/b].

[h3]We aim to shake the scene of deckbuilder games, like no one did before!😈 [/h3] 
Don't let anything stop you from adding [b]Inkborn [/b]to your Wishlist 😉

notes.title: Concordia: Digital Edition Salsa DLC is out!
notes.content:
[h1]The long awaited first major DLC for Concordia: Digital Edition is now available for purchase! [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/ace1ce32219990cb0b05c28ed1f4c5063a536072.jpg[/img]
 
As of now you can access [b]Salt [/b]and [b]Forum [/b]modules, and [b]Hispania [/b]and [b]Byzantium[/b] maps on [b]iOS[/b], [b]Android[/b], [b]Steam[/b], and [b]GOG[/b]!

[b]Salt[/b] is a new kind of trading good that can not be bought or sold - it can only be acquired from Salt producing cities. It's also the most valuable of all the trading goods, as it can serve as any other good for the purposes of house construction or points scoring!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/0d91ee370eba5be96bfa58b32c3b4ecd4c70ebc9.png[/img]

[b]Forum [/b]is a mechanic bringing a whole new set of Forum Cards, where you get patricians and regular citizens to help you throughout the game. The bonuses they provide are either a one-time use powerful ability or an ongoing change to core game mechanics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/30956dab5c2f60887dfd374f4412f7011e06a78e.png[/img]

[b]Hispania & Byzantium[/b] are the two maps that come with the [b]Salsa DLC[/b]. They don't bring any new mechanics by themselves, but the different layout in itself will significantly impact the gameplay and the tactics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/6bda6cb100f1ac2cea9273c71529f313963bcdd4.png[/img]

[h1]Last call for the tournament![/h1]

Don't forget you can still sign up for the [b]Concordia: Digital Edition Online Tournament![/b]
 
All you need is the base game of Concordia and the will to compete! The event is completely [b]free of charge[/b] and there are [b]real prizes to be won[/b] provided by us (Acram Digital) and PD-Verlag - the publisher of the tabletop Concordia! 

More information [b]here[/b].

notes.title: Concordia: Digital Edition - Salsa DLC releasing on the 01/27/22
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/a8a9b793b844bb91609911503d56995239b1554f.jpg[/img]

[h1]Big news for all you Concordia fans! [/h1]

[h2]The first of the three big DLC pieces is releasing next week - on the 27th of January 2022![/h2]

[b]Salsa [/b]introduces two modules - [b]Salt trading good[/b], and [b]Forum mechanic[/b], and two more additional [b]maps - Hispania and Byzantium[/b]!

[b]Salt [/b]is a new kind of trading good that can not be bought or sold - it can only be acquired from Salt producing cities. It's also the most valuable of all the trading goods, as it can serve as any other good for the purposes of house construction or points scoring!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/0d91ee370eba5be96bfa58b32c3b4ecd4c70ebc9.png[/img]

[b]Forum [/b]is a mechanic bringing a whole new set of Forum Cards, where you get patricians and regular citizens to help you throughout the game. The bonuses they provide are either a one-time use powerful ability or an ongoing change to core game mechanics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/30956dab5c2f60887dfd374f4412f7011e06a78e.png[/img]

[b]Hispania & Byzantium[/b] are the two maps that come with the Salsa DLC. They don't bring any new mechanics by themselves, but the different layout in itself will significantly impact the gameplay and the tactics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/6bda6cb100f1ac2cea9273c71529f313963bcdd4.png[/img]

[b]Salsa DLC[/b] has been in beta testing for a while now - both by the dedicated beta testers as well as the Season Pass owners who chose to try and err the beta content. 

And if you're excited about trying content early - you still can! [b]The Season Pass[/b] owners, regardless of platform, can always opt in and out of the beta content and try the DLCs mechanics and maps a bit ahead of time!

[h1]Add Salsa to your wishlist today![/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1707530/Concordia_Digital_Edition__Salsa/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1708670/Concordia_Digital_Edition__Season_Pass/

notes.title: Golden Train Edition
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that Easter promotion is available - a special package: [b][url=store.steampowered.com/bundle/2958/]Golden Train Edition[/url][/b], which includes the main application and all the additional maps in one bundle.

There are also some bug fixes:
- fixed bug when rail/city hex tile was dragged out of map’s borders from legal position,
- fixed rare bug occurring in multiplayer game, when one of players abandons the game during build tracks phase,
- fixed rare bug that made lack of player’s token on rails on expansion maps,
- more minor bug fixes and improvements: tutorial, bidding in basic mode and other.
